integrity_notes: The spectral claim has a self-contained proof and a separately executable supplementary verifier; no independent mathematical audit or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Sharp criterion is local to the positive homogeneous fixed point and assumes a finite connected symmetric graph and constant implicit shift.
At the critical eigenvalue -1 no nonlinear stability or two-cycle theorem is claimed.
For zero shift the implicit graph Laplacian is singular, extending the source setting though the resolvent remains nonsingular.
No statement about global convergence, variable steps, inhomogeneous potentials, weighted mass or alternative splitting variants.
title: Sharp local step boundary for Davis–Yin splitting at a homogeneous graph Gross–Pitaevskii ground state
